newsitem.title: USA: MESA, Parker & Parsley set to close merger.
newsitem.headline: MESA, Parker & Parsley set to close merger.

text.p: MESA Inc and Parker & Parsley Petroleum Co plan to close their merger following a special meeting called for August 7 in Dallas, the companies said on Tuesday.
The companies also have lined up $1.4 billion in loan commitments from a bank group that will be used to refinance their outstanding bank debt, the companies said.

The companies on April 7 agreed to merge in a $4.2 billion stock deal that includes $1.3 billion in combined debt. The merged company, Pioneer Natural Resources Co, will rank as the third largest U.S. independent oil and natural gas exploration and production company, they said.

The companies' joint proxy statement and prospectus was declared effective by the Securities and Exchange Commission, and proxy materials will be distributed to shareholders of record on Friday, June 27, the companies said.
The loan commitments were received from a bank group led by NationsBank of Texas NA, Chase Manhattan Bank, Morgan Guaranty Trust Co of New York and CIBC Inc, they said.
